howto.what: Claude 的每次 Read、Edit、Bash 都会变成一条压缩观察记录,会话结束时汇总;相关记录会自动注入以后的提示,让下一个会话带着上次的上下文开始,不必重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 当你问「claude-mem 是怎么工作的」或「这东西在干什么」这类原理问题时接管。记忆注入从你在同一项目里的第二个会话开始生效,第一个会话负责播种记忆。

say.note: 它会说明观察记录怎么采集和汇总

say.text: 我的记忆数据存在哪里?
say.note: 它会说明数据在本机 ~/.claude-mem 目录

say.text: 记忆注入什么时候开始生效?
say.note: 它会说明从项目里第二个会话开始

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation; observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts so the next session starts with context from the last.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask how claude-mem works or what it is doing. Memory injection starts on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory.

say_en.text: Where does my memory data live?
When does memory injection kick in?
